Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ModelChecker<I,M,P,R>
A model-checker checks whether a given model satisfies a given property. If the property can not be satisfied it provides counter examples.

      @Nullable R findCounterExample(M model, Collection<? extends I> inputs, P property)
      Try to find counter examples for the given property and model.
      Parameters:
      model - the model to check the property on.
      inputs - the alphabet.
      property - the property.
      Returns:
      the counter examples, or null if no counter examples exist.
      Throws:
      ModelCheckingException - when this model checker can not check the property.
